primary/80C_35percent_on_21_rows.qualification: This is not an assessment of the historical 104-row gate.

bounded_claim: Prediction of loaded 30 wt% MEA at 80 °C from loaded-solution parameters estimated only from ≤60 °C loaded-solution data, conditional on binary CO₂–water (Kiepe, 313–393 K) and MEA–water (Cai, 363–432 K) interactions fitted to binary-subsystem data that include higher temperatures; historical SSM+DS, dielectric and association choices are fixed conditions.

independent_delivered_review.scope: Bounded numerical verification and prediction comparison; not physical validation, adoption or manuscript promotion.
independent_delivered_review.independent_checks: All 176 pressure/species summary groups, heat summaries and finite-dose heats from retained endpoints; all 714 raw assessment states and material/charge balances; freeze, ordering and all 90 file hashes; installed 18-file RECORD and immutable Engine wheel; complete notebook, refreshed HTML and pressure SVG.
independent_delivered_review.optional_hardening: assessment.py names the signed mean mean_absolute_signed_error; notebook already correctly labels Mean signed error. No change made to this optional field-name suggestion.
independent_delivered_review.limitations: Incomplete constant-fixed attempts prevent its structural comparison; active bounds, the secondary weak Jacobian direction, source-law extrapolation and deferred folds/profiles prevent unrestricted identification; no normalized caloric adequacy; Bates PDF identity remains explicitly unrefreshed. Misfit does not establish a solver defect.
